item.title: Semiconductor Industry Demands 'Ultra-Pure Water'… Yeongsan River Water Quality is 'Very Poor' (‘초순수’ 필요한 반도체… 영산강 수질은 ‘매우 나쁨’)
item.description:
Semiconductor Industry Demands 'Ultra-Pure Water'… Yeongsan River Water Quality is 'Very Poor' (‘초순수’ 필요한 반도체… 영산강 수질은 ‘매우 나쁨’)

Since the announcement of the plan to build an 800 trillion won semiconductor plant (fab) in the Jeonnam-Gwangju region, the most frequently raised concern has been 'clean water'. On June 30, I visited Seungchonbo, a barrage on the Yeongsan River in Seungchon-dong, Nam-gu, Gwangju. This barrage, which first holds back water flowing from the main stem of the Yeongsan River originating in Damyang, Jeonnam, as well as from its primary tributaries, the Hwangryong River and Gwangju Stream, was constructed during the Lee Myung-bak administration's Four Major Rivers Project. Located a 15-minute drive from Gwangju Airport, one of the candidate sites for the Samsung Electronics semiconductor fab, it has a total storage capacity of 9 million tons. (800조원이 투입될 전남광주 반도체 공장(팹) 조성 계획을 발표한 이후 가장 많은 우려를 받는 항목은 ‘깨끗한 물’이다. 지난 6월 30일 찾아간 광주 남구 승촌동에 있는 영산강 승촌보. 전남 담양에서 발원하는 영산강 본류를 비롯해 제1지류인 황룡강과 광주천 등지에서 흘러내려오는 물을 1차로 가두는 승촌보는 이명박 정부 때 4대강 사업으로 들어선 보(洑)다. 삼성전자 반도체 팹 후보지 중 하나로 광주공항에서 차로 15분 거리에 있는 곳으로 총저수량은 900만t에 달한다.)

However, the water quality at Seungchonbo, as visually confirmed by this reporter on that day, appeared far from the 'ultra-pure water' grade 'clean water' required for a semiconductor plant. Upon collecting water in a transparent PET bottle at the Seungchonbo dock, light yellowish-brown fine particles were seen floating inside the bottle. Even to the naked eye, it seemed to contain impurities. Near the Seungchonbo dock, glass bottles and household waste were floating on the river surface, and fine bubbles were also visually observed. In semiconductor manufacturing, the wafer surface must be cleaned hundreds of times, and even a single microscopic ion, organic matter, or particle in the water can lead to circuit defects. Therefore, ultra-pure water, from which impurities are extremely removed, is essential, not ordinary water. (하지만 이날 기자가 육안으로 확인한 승촌보의 수질은 반도체 공장에 필요한 ‘초순수(超純水)’급 ‘맑은 물’과는 거리가 있어 보였다. 승촌보 선착장에 내려가 가지고 간 투명 페트병으로 물을 떠보니 옅은 황갈색의 미세입자가 병 속에서 둥둥 떠다녔다. 육안으로 보기에도 불순물이 섞여 있는 듯했다. 승촌보 선착장 부근에는 유리병, 생활쓰레기 등도 강물 위에 떠다녔고 미세한 기포 역시 육안으로 관찰됐다. 반도체 공정에서는 웨이퍼 표면을 수백 번 이상 세정해야 하고, 물 속의 미세한 이온·유기물·입자 하나도 회로 불량으로 이어질 수 있다. 이 때문에 일반 물이 아닌 불순물을 극도로 제거한 초순수가 필수적이다.)

Water Quality of Yeongsan River Seungchonbo and Wolsanbo (영산강 승촌보와 월산보 수질 )

According to the 'Water Information Portal' operated by K-water, the water quality around Seungchonbo on the Yeongsan River is at a 'very poor' level. The Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) level, a measure of overall water pollution, recorded 11.7. The COD level of the Hwangryong River (the primary tributary of the Yeongsan River), which originates in Jangseong, Jeonnam, and flows into Seungchonbo, was 7.7, rated 'slightly poor'. The water quality worsens by about 1.5 times as it passes through Gwangju city. The Total Organic Carbon (TOC) level, an indicator of organic matter and carbon in the water, was also 9.6, rated 'very poor'. Professor Hwang Yoo-hoon of the Department of Environmental Engineering at Seoul National University of Science and Technology stated, "If the COD level exceeds 10, it is classified as Grade 5 water, making it nearly unusable for general domestic purposes. While it might be usable as industrial water, the poor water quality means higher costs and more complex purification processes." (한국수자원공사가 운영하는 ‘물정보포털’에 따르면, 영산강 승촌보 일대의 수질은 ‘매우 나쁨’ 수준이다. 전반적인 수질 오염 정도를 나타내는 화학적 산소 소비량 수치인 COD 수치 역시 11.7을 기록했다. 전남 장성에서 발원해 승촌보로 이어지는 황룡강(영산강 제1지류)의 COD 수치는 7.7로 ‘약간 나쁨’ 수준인데, 광주 시내를 통과하면서 이보다 약 1.5배 이상 수질이 나빠진 것이다. 수중에 존재하는 유기물과 탄소의 양을 나타내는 오염 수치인 TOC 수치 역시 9.6으로 ‘매우 나쁨’ 수준이었다. 황유훈 서울과기대 환경공학과 교수는 “COD 수치가 10이 넘어가면 5급수로 규정하도록 돼 있고 일반 생활용수로는 거의 사용이 어렵다”며 “산업용수로써 활용이 가능은 하겠지만 수질이 안 좋은 만큼 정수 과정과 비용이 더 많이 든다”고 말했다.)

The situation is not significantly different in the upper reaches of the Yeongsan River. At Wolsanbo on the Yeongsan River, a 12-minute drive from the Gwangju Advanced Industrial Complex in Buk-gu, Gwangju—another candidate site for the semiconductor fab—water collected in a PET bottle was also filled with impurities. (이 같은 상황은 영산강 상류 역시 크게 다르지 않다. 또 다른 반도체 팹 후보지인 광주 북구 첨단지구에서 차로 12분 거리에 있는 영산강 월산보에서도 직접 페트병에 물을 담아 보니 불순물이 가득했다.)

Wolsanbo, a hydraulic structure near the second mid-stream island of the Yeongsan River, was completed in 1997. The water collected there was darker in color than that from Seungchonbo further downstream, and more green algae, twigs, and fine particles were observed. Notably, the water volume near Wolsanbo was noticeably lower than at Seungchonbo, with parts of the riverbed exposed and cracked downstream of the barrage. Green algae and duckweed were present downstream of the barrage, and household waste such as PET bottles and cardboard boxes washed in from nearby areas were spotted in several places. (영산강 제2하중도 인근에 있는 월산보는 1997년 준공된 수리시설인데, 하류에 있는 승촌보에서 뜬 물보다 색이 더 짙었고 녹조, 잔가지, 미세입자 등은 오히려 더 많이 관찰됐다. 특히 월산보 일대는 승촌보에 비해 눈에 띄게 수량도 부족했는데, ‘보’ 하류에는 강바닥을 드러내며 갈라져 있는 부분도 보였다. 보 하류에는 녹조와 개구리밥 등이 끼어 있는 상태였고, 인근에서 떠밀려온 페트병, 종이박스 등 생활쓰레기도 곳곳에서 목격됐다.)

The COD level at Wolsanbo was also 8.2, rated 'poor', and the TOC level was 6.5, also rated 'poor'. Lee Mo (68), a resident of Woljeong Village in Jangseong-gun, said, "I understand that no one farms around the Wolsan pumping station (located at Wolsanbo) these days. The water is dirty because the barrage was built not too long ago and levee repair work is underway nearby." Indeed, there was a considerable amount of construction waste near Wolsanbo. (월산보의 COD 수치도 8.2로 ‘나쁨’ 수준이었고 TOC 수치 역시 6.5로 ‘나쁨’을 기록했다. 장성군 월정마을 주민 이모(68)씨는 “월산양수장(월산보 소재 양수장) 쪽에서는 농사를 짓는 사람이 요즘 없는 것으로 안다”며 “보가 만들어진 지 얼마 안 됐고 근처에서 둑 보수 공사가 진행 중이라 물도 더럽다”고 말했다. 실제로 월산보 인근에서는 공사로 인한 폐기물이 적지 않은 모습이었다.)

Kim Sung-hwan: "Secure 650,000 Tons of Water Daily" (김성환 “하루 65만t 용수 확보 가능” )

Naturally, securing water resources is an urgent issue for the construction of the Gwangju semiconductor fab, often called a 'water hog'. Kim Sung-hwan, Minister of Climate, Energy, and Environment, confidently stated at a June 29 briefing at the presidential office announcing the plan for the 'Honam Semiconductor Cluster', "Although the Yeongsan River and Seomjin River basin areas are smaller than those of the Han River or Nakdong River, there are 7 dams. We can secure over 650,000 tons of water per day." However, it remains uncertain whether this calculation will hold during extreme weather events like those in 2023, which led to drinking water shortages. (자연히 ‘물먹는 하마’로 불리는 광주 반도체 팹 조성에 있어 수자원 확보는 발등에 떨어진 불이다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관은 지난 6월 29일 청와대에서 ‘호남 반도체 클러스터’ 조성계획을 발표하는 자리에서 “영산강과 섬진강 유역 면적이 한강이나 낙동강보다 작지만 7개의 댐이 있다”며 “하루 약 65만t 이상의 용수를 확보할 수 있다”고 호언장담했다. 하지만 2023년과 같은 이상기후로 인해 식수마저 부족해질 때 이 같은 계산이 통할지는 미지수다.)

In particular, some point out that the existing dams and barrages in the Yeongsan River system, which flows through Gwangju, are insufficient even for supplying water to the semiconductor fab. Dams in the Yeongsan River system—Naju Dam (total storage approx. 107.8 million tons), Jangseong Dam (138 million tons), Damyang Dam (77.6 million tons), Gwangju Dam (17.3 million tons), and Pyeongnim Dam (8.5 million tons)—are mere drops in the bucket compared to the Soyang Dam (2.9 billion tons) in the Han River system, which boasts the largest storage capacity in the country. Transporting water from Daecheong Dam (1.49 billion tons) in the Geum River system via pipeline is an option, but it faces strong opposition from the Chungcheong region. (특히 광주를 가로지르는 영산강 수계에 조성된 기존 댐과 보만으로는 반도체 팹에 용수를 공급하는 것조차 역부족이란 지적도 나온다. 영산강 수계에 들어선 나주댐(총저수량 약 1억780만t), 장성댐(1억380만t), 담양댐(7760만t), 광주댐(1730만t), 평림댐(850만t) 등은 국내 최대 저수용량을 자랑하는 한강 수계에 있는 소양강댐(29억t)에 비하면 새 발의 피다. 금강 수계인 대청댐(14억9000만t)의 물을 관로로 끌어오는 방법도 있지만 충청권의 반발이 거세다.)

Consequently, the government and the Jeonnam-Gwangju authorities plan to draw 150,000 tons, 100,000 tons, and 100,000 tons from Jangheung Dam (191 million tons), Naju Dam (91.2 million tons), and Boseong River Dam (4.7 million tons), respectively. They are also considering expanding Juam Dam (457 million tons) and Dongbok Dam (99.5 million tons) in the Seomjin River system to bring in 150,000 tons and 300,000 tons of industrial water, respectively. However, there are concerns that diverting water from the Seomjin River system to Gwangju could cause water shortages for the Yeosu petrochemical complex and POSCO's Gwangyang steelworks. (이에 정부와 전남광주시는 장흥댐(1억9100만t), 나주댐(9120만t), 보성강댐(470만t)에서 각각 15만t, 10만t, 10만t을 끌어올 계획이다. 또 섬진강 수계에 있는 주암댐(4억5700만t)과 동복댐(9950만t)을 증설해 각각 15만t과 30만t의 공업용수를 끌어오는 방안도 검토 중이다. 다만 섬진강 수계의 물을 광주로 돌릴 경우, 여수 석유화학단지와 포스코 광양제철소의 용수부족 문제가 야기될 수 있다는 우려도 나온다.)

Using the water as ultra-pure water for the semiconductor industry also requires essential water purification. The Yeongsan River suffers from insufficient volume and significant water pollution from livestock manure (cattle, pigs, poultry). For these reasons, the citizens of Gwangju, the largest city in Honam with a population of 1.5 million, have long used water drawn not from the nearby Yeongsan River but from Dongbok Lake in Hwasun, Jeonnam, and Juam Lake in Suncheon, both part of the Seomjin River system, as their drinking water. Currently, there are five major water treatment facilities in Gwangju and Jangseong: Jangseong Water Treatment Plant (Jangseong-gun), Gakhwa Water Treatment Plant (Buk-gu, Gwangju), Deoknam Water Treatment Plant (Nam-gu, Gwangju), Jiwon Water Treatment Plant (Dong-gu, Gwangju), and Yongyeon Water Treatment Plant (Dong-gu, Gwangju). Among these, only the Yongyeon Water Treatment Plant is capable of 'advanced water treatment'. (반도체 산업용 초순수로 쓰기 위해서는 수질정화 역시 필수적이다. 영산강은 수량이 부족하고 소·돼지·가금류 등이 배설한 농축산 분뇨로 인한 수질오염도 심각하다. 이 같은 사정으로 인구 150만명의 호남 최대 도시인 광주 시민들은 오래전부터 바로 옆에 있는 영산강이 아닌 섬진강 수계에 있는 전남 화순의 동복호와 순천의 주암호에서 길어올린 물을 식수로 사용하는 실정이다. 현재 광주와 장성 등지에는 장성정수장(장성군), 각화정수장(광주 북구), 덕남정수장(광주 남구), 지원정수장(광주 동구), 용연정수장(광주 동구) 등 주요 정수 시설이 5곳이 있는데, 이 중 ‘고도정수처리’가 가능한 시설은 용연정수장 정도에 그친다.)

Ultimately, constructing the semiconductor fab necessitates the installation of large-scale hydraulic structures like dams and barrages. Given the political opposition that accompanied the construction of such facilities in the past, there is significant concern that this opposition could resurface. During the Lee Myung-bak administration's Four Major Rivers Project, the Seungchonbo in Gwangju and Juksanbo in Naju, built on the Yeongsan River system, have consistently faced demands for opening and dismantling from local politicians and environmental groups. In particular, during the Moon Jae-in administration, which disparaged the Four Major Rivers Project as 'digging holes' under the banner of 'renaturalization', the presidential National Water Management Committee (then chaired by Prime Minister Jeong Sye-kyun) decided to "keep Seungchonbo permanently open and dismantle Juksanbo." Amidst this, a K-water official told Weekly Chosun, "The announcements made by the presidential office and the Climate Ministry are all that's available now, and only a big picture has been drawn. Detailed plans will likely progress only when the factory plans become more concrete." (결국 반도체 팹 조성을 위해서는 댐과 보 등 대규모 수리시설 설치가 필수적인데, 과거 수리시설 건설 때 보였던 정치적 반대를 감안하면 이 같은 반대가 또다시 재현될 수 있다는 우려도 크다. 이명박 정부 시절 4대강 사업을 추진하면서 영산강 수계에 건설한 광주 승촌보와 나주 죽산보는 줄곧 지역 정치인과 환경단체들로부터 개방·해체 요구에 시달려 왔다. 특히 ‘재자연화’라는 미명하에 4대강 사업을 ‘삽질’로 매도했던 문재인 정부 시절 대통령 직속 국가물관리위원회(위원장 정세균 당시 국무총리)는 “승촌보는 상시개방하고, 죽산보는 해체하라”는 결정을 내린 바 있다. 이 가운데 한국수자원공사 측은 주간조선에 “청와대와 기후부 측에서 발표한 내용이 현재 전부이고 큰 그림만 그려진 상황”이라며 “자세한 계획은 공장 계획이 더 구체화되어야 진행이 될 것 같다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] China Releases Korean-Chinese Pastor Jin Mingri... Trump Directly Raised the Issue with Xi ([단독] 中, 조선족 김명일 목사 석방… 트럼프가 習에 직접 문제 제기)
item.description:
[Exclusive] China Releases Korean-Chinese Pastor Jin Mingri... Trump Directly Raised the Issue with Xi ([단독] 中, 조선족 김명일 목사 석방… 트럼프가 習에 직접 문제 제기)

It was learned on the 4th that Chinese authorities have released Pastor Jin Mingri (known in Chinese as Jin Mingri, 57), a Korean-Chinese individual arrested in October last year, after nine months of detention. Pastor Jin was arrested for leading China's largest underground evangelical church. The Chinese government has outlawed religious activities such as preaching and worship in homes and elsewhere, except in churches officially authorized by the authorities. President Donald Trump had called for Pastor Jin's release during a summit meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in May, and this action came about two months later. Trump also secured the release of missionaries detained in North Korea during his first term. (중국 당국이 지난해 10월 체포한 조선족 김명일(중국 이름 진밍르·57) 목사를 구금 9개월 만에 석방한 것으로 4일 알려졌다. 김 목사는 복음주의 성향인 중국 최대 지하 교회를 이끌다 체포됐는데, 중국 정부는 당국의 공식 허가를 받은 교회를 제외하고 가정 등에서 설교·예배 등을 벌이는 종교 활동을 불법화하고 있다. 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 지난 5월 시진핑(習近平) 중국 국가주석과의 정상회담에서 김 목사에 대한 석방을 요구했는데, 이번 조치는 2개월 여 만에 이뤄진 것이다. 트럼프는 1기 때도 북한에 억류된 선교사들에 대한 석방을 요구해 이를 관철시켰다.)

Pastor Jin reportedly arrived in Los Angeles, California, on the same day and was reunited with his family after eight years. Grace Jin, his eldest daughter, said in a statement sent to this newspaper: "We truly witnessed a miracle and are overwhelmed with joy." She added, "We sincerely thank everyone for their support and prayers from the beginning to now." She also expressed gratitude for "President Trump and his administration's outstanding leadership." Jin noted, "We are well aware that this could not have happened without President Xi's direct intervention," and expressed hope that "this will serve as a positive turning point for believers in China and for bilateral relations." (김 목사는 이날 미 서부 로스앤젤레스(LA)에 도착해 가족과 8년 만에 재회를 한 것으로 전해졌다. 김씨의 장녀인 그레이스 진씨는 본지에 보낸 성명에서 “우리는 진정으로 기적(miracle)을 목격해 기쁨으로 가슴이 벅차오른다(overwhelmed with joy)”며 “처음부터 지금까지 보내주신 모든 분들의 응원과 기도에 진심으로 감사드린다”고 했다. 이어 “트럼프 대통령과 행정부의 탁월한 리더십에 감사하다”고 했다. 진씨는 “시 주석의 직접적인 개입이 없었다면 이런 일이 일어날 수 없었을 것임을 잘 알고 있다”며 “이번 일이 중국 내 신앙인들과 양국 관계에 긍정적인 전환점이 되기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Pastor Jin, a native of Heilongjiang Province and a graduate of Peking University, converted to Christianity in 1989 following the Tiananmen Square incident. After earning a Ph.D. in theology in the United States, he returned to China to lead the evangelical Zion Church. The church drew large crowds, holding Sunday services in over 40 cities across China, with up to 5,000 people joining online to listen to sermons and participate in worship. However, as Communist Party restrictions on activities intensified, he sent his family to the United States in 2018. His spouse, Liu Chunli, said in an interview with this newspaper last year: "Things became much harder after I opposed authorities installing cameras on the first floor of the church to monitor attendees." Pastor Jin was eventually arrested by Chinese authorities last year on charges of "illegal dissemination of information." (헤이룽장성 출신으로 베이징대를 졸업한 김 목사는 1989년 천안문 사태를 계기로 입교(入敎)했고, 미국에서 신학 박사 학위를 취득한 뒤 중국으로 돌아와 복음주의 성향 시온교회를 이끌었다. 중국 내 40여 도시에서 주일 예배를 운영하고 5000명이 온라인에 접속해 설교를 듣고 예배에 참석할 정도로 문전성시를 이뤘는데, 공산당의 활동 제약이 심해지면서 가족을 2018년 미국으로 이주시켰다. 배우자 류춘리씨는 지난해 본지 인터뷰에서 “(당국이) 예배당 1층에 카메라를 설치해 출입자를 파악하겠다는 것을 반대한 뒤 많이 힘들어졌다”고 했는데, 지난해 ‘불법 정보 유포’ 혐의를 받아 중국 당국에 체포됐다.)

Trump stated in May that he had directly raised the issue of Pastor Jin's arrest and detention with President Xi, noting that "President Xi is seriously considering releasing Pastor Jin." Beyond Trump, both houses of the U.S. Congress passed a bipartisan resolution calling for his release ahead of U.S.-China talks, while influential Washington D.C. foreign policy and security think tanks, such as the Hudson Institute, pushed the issue into the public spotlight to pressure the Chinese government. Secretary of State Marco Rubio issued a critical statement, calling the "persecution based on faith a clear violation of religious freedom." In particular, Grace Jin traveled across the U.S., urging support for her father's release. Jin, who also goes by the Korean name "Kim Jeong-ah," told this newspaper in a phone interview in May: "My father is not even a U.S. citizen, but I am deeply grateful to President Trump for not forgetting a detained individual and raising it as if it were his own concern." (트럼프는 지난 5월 시 주석에게 김 목사 체포·구금 문제를 직접 언급했다고 밝히며 “시 주석이 김 목사 석방을 진지하게 검토하고 있다”고 했다. 트럼프뿐만 아니라 미 조야(朝野)에선 상·하원이 미·중 회담을 앞두고 석방을 요구하는 초당적 결의안을 통과시켰고, 허드슨연구소 같은 워싱턴 DC의 유력 외교·안보 싱크 탱크가 나서서 이 문제를 공론화하며 중국 정부를 압박했다. 마코 루비오 국무장관은 “신앙을 이유로 한 탄압은 종교 자유에 대한 명백한 침해”라며 비판 성명을 냈다. 특히 김씨의 장녀인 진씨가 전국 곳곳을 누비며 부친 석방을 위해 힘을 모아 달라는 목소리를 냈다. ‘김정아’란 한국 이름을 가진 진씨는 지난 5월 본지 통화에서 “우리 아버지는 미국 시민권자도 아니지만 억류된 시민을 잊지 않고 마치 개인의 일처럼 언급해 준 트럼프 대통령께 정말 감사한 마음”이라고 했었다.)

Although Pastor Jin is a Korean-Chinese with Chinese nationality, his elderly mother reportedly lives in South Korea. Jin said, "My only wish is for my grandmother to see my father one last time before she passes away." Even access for lawyers to meet with Pastor Jin was restricted, and inquiries for consular assistance from the South Korean embassy reportedly drew no response. Jin last saw her father in 2018. Now pregnant with her third child and close to giving birth, Jin said, "I truly hope and pray that my father can return to the U.S. and live with us," adding, "I hope he can fulfill the roles of husband, father, and grandfather that he has missed for the past eight years." (김 목사는 중국 국적을 갖고 있는 조선족이지만, 고령의 모친은 현재 한국에 살고 있다고 한다. 진씨는 “할머니가 마지막으로 숨을 거두시기 전에 아버지를 한 번이라도 뵙게 해드리는 것 외에 바라는 게 없다”고 했다. 변호사조차 김 목사와 접견이 제한된 상황에서 우리 대사관 측에도 영사 조력을 문의했지만 별다른 반응이 없었다고 한다. 진씨가 마지막으로 부친을 본 것은 2018년이었다. 셋째를 임신해 곧 출산을 앞두고 있는 진씨는 “아버지가 미국으로 돌아와 우리와 함께 지낼 수 있기를 정말로 바라고 기도한다”며 “지난 8년 동안 못 했던 남편, 아버지, 그리고 할아버지의 역할을 다할 수 있기를 바란다”고 했었다.)

item.title: When Moon went to Pyongyang, Lee was excluded... Pro-Moon and Pro-Lee factions have crossed a point of no return (文 평양 갈 때 李 배제...친문·친명 돌아올 수 없는 다리 건넜다)
item.description:
When Moon went to Pyongyang, Lee was excluded... Pro-Moon and Pro-Lee factions have crossed a point of no return (文 평양 갈 때 李 배제...친문·친명 돌아올 수 없는 다리 건넜다)

President Lee Jae-myung invited former President Moon Jae-in to the presidential office for the first time on the 1st, sharing a lunch together. President Lee waited in front of the Green Garden at the presidential office before former President Moon arrived and greeted him with a bright smile. The presidential office unusually released all footage, including the two embracing, conversing, and moving to Sangchunjae. One media outlet introduced this under the headline "19-minute lunch meeting disclosed in a surprise move." (이재명 대통령이 지난 1일 문재인 전 대통령을 처음으로 청와대로 초청해 오찬을 함께했습니다. 이 대통령은 문 전 대통령이 도착하기 전부터 청와대 녹지원 앞에서 기다렸다가 환한 웃음으로 맞이했습니다. 청와대는 두 사람이 포옹하고 대화하며 상춘재로 이동하는 장면까지 이례적으로 모두 공개했습니다. 한 매체는 이를 ’19분 오찬 회동 전격 공개’라는 제목으로 소개하기도 했습니다.)

Lee-Moon meeting unusually released in full length (이재명-문재인 회동 이례적으로 길게 공개 )

However, many in political circles view this as "staging" rather than "reconciliation." This is because there was a need to show an image of unity amid the Democratic Party's internal conflicts. Political commentator Park Sung-min, who writes a column for the Chosun Ilbo, assessed this in his piece "How to Watch the Decade-Cycle Civil War in the Democratic Party." (하지만 정치권에서는 이를 ‘화해’보다 ‘연출’로 보는 시각이 많습니다. 민주당 내부 갈등이 심상치 않은 상황에서 통합 이미지를 보여줄 필요가 있었기 때문이라는 것입니다. 조선일보에 칼럼을 연재 중인 정치평론가 박성민 씨는 ‘10년 주기 민주당 내전 관전법’에서 이같이 평가했습니다.)

"President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in met to patch up the (Democratic Party's) division. The fact that they both emphasized 'unity' is proof that the party is hurtling toward division. Like the 'Kindleberger Trap' in international politics, President Lee Jae-myung has no will to prevent division, and former President Moon Jae-in has no power." ( “(민주당) 분열을 봉합하기 위해 이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령이 만났다. 한 목소리로 ‘통합’을 강조한 건 당이 분열로 치닫고 있다는 반증입니다. 국제 정치의 ‘킨들버거 함정’처럼 이재명 대통령은 분열을 막을 의지가 없고, 문재인 전 대통령은 힘이 없다.”)

The Kindleberger Trap refers to a phenomenon where a crisis occurs when a rising hegemonic power fails to properly take over the role of maintaining peace from the existing hegemon. While this may not be a perfect analogy for the Democratic Party's growing division ahead of the August national convention, it is a prediction that cooperation between the two is unlikely and internal chaos within the party will worsen. (킨들버거의 함정(Kindleberger Trap)은 신흥 패권국이 기존 패권국을 대신해 평화 유지를 위한 역할을 제대로 못 할 때 위기가 발생하는 현상을 말합니다. 현재 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 분열이 커지는 민주당 상황에 딱 들어맞는 비유는 아니지만, 두 사람의 협력을 기대하기 어렵고 민주당 내부의 혼란이 더욱 커질 것이라는 예측입니다.)

Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung excluded from Pyongyang summit (평양 정상회담 동행 못한 이재명 경기지사)

Among former Democratic Party presidents, Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun maintained relatively close relations. In contrast, many assess that the rift between former President Moon Jae-in and President Lee Jae-myung is much deeper. Recently, even Yoo Si-min, former chairman of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation and a member of the pro-Moon faction, took a direct shot at President Lee, saying, "What the public wanted was an expansion (of the democratic camp), but the president tried to do a reconstruction." He also compared the pro-Lee faction's criticism of the pro-Moon faction to an "autoimmune disease." This is a representative example of the open conflict between the two sides. (역대 민주당 대통령 가운데 김대중 대통령과 노무현 대통령은 비교적 긴밀한 관계를 유지했습니다. 이에 비해 문재인 전 대통령과 이재명 대통령의 관계는 갈등의 골이 훨씬 깊다는 평가가 많습니다. 최근 친문 진영에 속하는 유시민 전 노무현재단 이사장마저 이 대통령을 향해 “대중이 원한 것은 (민주진영의) 증축이었는데 대통령은 재건축을 하려고 했다”고 직격했습니다. 친명 진영의 친문 세력에 대한 비판을 ‘자가면역질환’에 비유하기도 했습니다. 양측의 갈등이 공개적으로 드러난 대표적 장면입니다.)

Political circles view the point when the relationship between the two soured the most as the inter-Korean summit in Pyongyang in September 2018. On September 16, two days before President Moon's visit to Pyongyang, Chief of Staff Im Jong-seok announced the list of special delegates for the Pyongyang summit. From the business sector, Samsung Electronics Vice Chairman Lee Jae-yong, SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won, LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo, and other major conglomerate heads were included, while from local governments, Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon and Gangwon Governor Choi Moon-soon were selected. (정치권에서는 두 사람 관계가 가장 크게 틀어진 시점을 2018년 9월 평양에서 열린 남북 정상회담으로 보고 있습니다. 문 대통령의 평양 방문 이틀전인 9월 16일 임종석 비서실장이 평양 정상회담 특별수행원 명단을 발표했습니다. 경제계에서는 삼성전자 이재용 부회장, SK 최태원 회장, LG 구광모 회장 등 주요 기업 총수들이 포함됐고, 지방자치단체장으로는 박원순 서울시장과 최문순 강원도지사가 선정됐습니다.)

Mayor Park was chosen in his capacity as chairman of the Association of Provincial Governors, and Governor Choi under the justification of being the head of a border-region metropolitan government. (박 시장은 전국시도지사협의회장 자격으로, 최 지사는 접경지역 광역단체장 명분으로 발탁됐습니다.)

However, Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung, whose province has the largest share of border areas, was not included on the list. Gyeonggi Province includes seven border-region local governments: Paju, Gimpo, Yeoncheon, Pocheon, Dongducheon, Goyang, and Yangju. Despite this, Gyeonggi Province was left out. The presidential office did not explain why Governor Lee was excluded. (그러나 접경지역을 가장 많이 보유한 경기도의 이재명 지사는 명단에 포함되지 않았습니다. 경기도에는 파주·김포·연천·포천·동두천·고양·양주 등 7개 접경 지역의 기초자치단체가 포함돼 있었습니다. 그럼에도 경기도는 포함되지 않았습니다. 청와대는 이 지사가 제외된 이유를 설명하지 않았습니다.)

"Strong aversion to Governor Lee within the pro-Moon faction" (“친문 진영서 이 지사에 대한 거부감 컸다”)

According to sources close to the ruling camp, there was considerable aversion to Governor Lee Jae-myung within the presidential office and pro-Moon faction at the time. In particular, they were enraged when Lee, then Mayor of Seongnam, who ran in the 2017 Democratic Party presidential primary, repeatedly raised issues regarding allegations about Moon's son, Jun-yong, and his hiring at the Korea Employment Information Service. Lee stated, "It cannot be said that there is no problem at all. The fact that necessary documents were submitted after the interview requires an explanation (from candidate Moon)." Although the issue had been raised by the Saenuri Party, People's Party, and Bareun Party and had been explained, Governor Lee's repeated mention of it led to backlash, with comments like, "Isn't this going too far?" (여권 관계자들에 따르면 당시 청와대와 친문 진영에서는 이재명 지사에 대한 거부감이 적지 않았습니다. 특히 2017년 민주당 대통령 후보 경선에 나선 이재명 당시 성남시장이 문 후보의 아들 준용씨의 한국고용정보원 채용 논란과 관련해 “전혀 문제가 없다곤 할 수 없다. 입사에 필요한 서류를 면접 이후 냈다는 것은 (문 후보 의) 해명이 필요하다”고 하는 등 여러 차례 문제를 제기하자 격분했습니다. 문 후보와 그의 측근들은 새누리당, 국민의당, 바른정당 등에서 제기했으나 해명이 된 사안에 대해 이 지사가 거듭 언급하자 “해도 너무하는 것 아니냐”고 반발했습니다.)

One source close to former President Moon said: (문 전 대통령과 가까운 한 인사는 이렇게 말합니다.)

"Honestly, within the pro-Moon faction, the aversion to Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung was far greater than is known. In the 2017 Democratic Party presidential primary process, he strongly raised suspicions of preferential hiring for President Moon's son, and feelings were already significantly soured due to the 'Lady Hyegyeonggung Kim' controversy. After President Moon took office, the wounds from the primary were deep, and there was a sentiment that there was no need to include Governor Lee, whose image was already tarnished from various investigations at the time, in the presidential delegation to North Korea." (“솔직히 친문 진영에서는 이재명 경기지사에 대한 거부감이 알려진 것보다 훨씬 더 컸다. 2017년 민주당 대선 경선 과정에서 문 대통령의 아들 취업 특혜 의혹을 강하게 제기한 데다 ‘혜경궁 김씨’ 논란으로 감정이 상당히 나빠져 있었다. 문 대통령 취임 후, 경선 과정에서 상처가 컸고 당시 이런저런 수사를 받느라 이미지가 좋지 않은 이 지사를 굳이 대통령 방북단에 포함시킬 필요가 있느냐는 분위기가 있었다.”)

"Now that he's president, why bring up primary issues?" ( “대통령이 됐으면서 경선 때 문제 삼느냐”)

On the other hand, people close to President Lee Jae-myung see it differently. They argue that while various controversies arise during party primaries, it is customary for the victor to show magnanimity. Moreover, they say it is problematic to exclude someone from important state affairs based on primary issues when that person has become president, the ruler of South Korea—not just any other position. (반면 이재명 대통령 측 인사들은 다르게 생각합니다. 당내 경선을 치르다 보면 이런저런 논란이 생기지만 승자가 아량을 보여주는 것이 관행이라는 겁니다. 더욱이 다른 관직도 아니고 대한민국을 통치하는 대통령이 됐음에도 경선 때의 문제로 중요한 국사(國事)에서 배제하는 것은 문제가 있다는 겁니다.)

In particular, President Lee was known as the most proactive politician among local government heads on North Korean issues, so his disappointment was great. After becoming Seongnam mayor in 2010, he showed great interest in inter-Korean exchanges and invited former Unification Minister Lee Jong-seok multiple times to hold lectures. In 2016, he established the Seongnam Inter-Korean Exchange and Cooperation Committee, the first among local governments nationwide. After being inaugurated as Gyeonggi Governor in 2018, he created the position of Peace Vice Governor, the only one among metropolitan governments. He also considered holding his inauguration ceremony at Imjingak and pushed for expanding the inter-Korean exchange and cooperation fund by 20 billion won to around 40 billion won, promoting inter-Korean exchanges at the local government level as a key policy. Consequently, those around Governor Lee said, "He believed he was more prepared than anyone on North Korean issues, but he was excluded from the most important stage." (특히 이 대통령은 지방자치단체장 가운데 북한 문제에 가장 적극적인 정치인으로 꼽혀왔기에 실망은 컸습니다. 이 대통령은 2010년 성남시장이 되면서 남북교류에 큰 관심을 보였고, 이종석 전 통일부 장관을 여러 차례 초청해 강연회를 열었습니다. 2016년에는 전국 기초자치단체 가운데 처음으로 성남시 남북교류협력위원회를 설치했습니다.2018년 경기지사에 취임한 후에는 광역자치단체 가운데 유일하게 평화부지사 제도를 신설했습니다. 취임식을 임진각에서 개최하는 방안도 검토했고, 남북교류협력기금을 200억원 추가, 약 400억원으로 대폭 확대하는 등 지방정부 차원의 남북교류를 핵심 정책으로 추진했습니다. 그렇기에 이재명 지사 주변에서는 “북한 문제만큼은 자신이 누구보다 준비돼 있다고 생각했는데 가장 중요한 무대에서 제외됐다”는 말이 나왔습니다.)

According to sources close to him at the time, Governor Lee was deeply shocked that Mayor Park Won-soon and Governor Choi Moon-soon, who were less active on North Korean issues, went to Pyongyang while he was excluded. (이 지사는 자신보다 북한 문제에 소극적이었던 박원순 시장과 최문순 지사는 평양에 가는데 정작 자신은 배제된 데 대해 상당한 충격을 받았다는 것이 당시 주변 인사들의 전언입니다.)

Pursuing independent North Korea projects (독자적 대북 사업 추진)

Political circles believe that around this time, Governor Lee Jae-myung began pursuing independent inter-Korean exchange projects. In November 2018, Governor Lee held the "International Conference for Peace and Prosperity in the Asia-Pacific" in Goyang with the Asia-Pacific Peace Exchange Association, led by Chairman Ahn Boo-soo, a supporter of his. At that event, Vice Chairman Ri Jong-hyok and Director Kim Song-hye of North Korea's Asia-Pacific Peace Committee attended. In his welcoming speech, Gyeonggi Governor Lee Jae-myung said, "The South and North are standing here together, looking into each other's eyes. Gyeonggi Province will do its utmost for prosperity, going beyond peace on the Korean Peninsula to become a hub of the Northeast Asian peace economy community." (정치권에서는 이 무렵부터 이재명 지사가 독자적인 남북 교류 사업을 추진하기 시작했다고 보고 있습니다. 이 지사는 2018년 11월 자신을 지지하는 안부수 회장이 이끄는 아태평화교류협회와 고양에서 ‘아시아태평양의 평화와 번영을 위한 국제대회’를 개최했는데, 이때 북한 조선아시아태평양평화위원회 리종혁 부위원장과 김성혜 실장 등이 참석했습니다. 이재명 경기 지사는 환영사에서 “남북이 이곳에서 함께 발 디딘 채 서로 눈을 맞추고 있다. 경기도가 한반도 평화를 넘어 동북아시아 평화경제 공동체의 중심으로서 번영을 위해 최선을 다할 것”이라고 했습니다.)

Gyeonggi Peace Vice Governor Lee Hwa-young drew attention by telling the media that the North Korean side had invited Governor Lee to Pyongyang, stating, "There was active discussion, with Vice Chairman Ri Jong-hyok even suggesting he come early via a different route instead of by land." The following year, a similar event was held in Manila, the Philippines. (이화영 경기도 평화 부지사는 언론에 북한측에서 이 지사를 평양으로 초청했다며 “(북한의) 이종혁 부위원장이 육로 대신 다른 경로로 일찍 오는 것을 권할 정도로 적극적인 논의가 있었다”고 밝혀 눈길을 끌었습니다. 이듬해에는 필리핀 마닐라에서도 같은 행사가 열렸습니다.)

In this process, Gyeonggi Province and the Asia-Pacific Peace Exchange Association cooperated closely. Chairman Ahn Boo-soo of the association, who brought North Korean high-ranking officials for two consecutive years, is a key figure in the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case. The prosecution conducted an investigation, judging that Ssangbangwool Group made remittances to North Korea during this period of inter-Korean exchanges. Chairman Ahn, along with former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Sung-tae, is accused of delivering foreign currency to North Korea's Asia-Pacific Peace Committee Chairman Kim Yong-chul in December 2018 and January 2019. Chairman Ahn was sentenced to three years and six months in prison in the first trial but had his sentence reduced to one year and six months on appeal in February 2025. He also faced prosecution investigation on suspicions of "statement inducement and bribery" related to this case. President Lee has since denied related allegations, but legal and political controversy continues, making it one of the major judicial risks surrounding him. (이 과정에서 경기도와 아태평화교류협회가 긴밀히 협력했는데, 2년 연속 북한 측 고위 인사를 데려온 이 협회의 안부수 회장은 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건의 핵심 인물입니다. 검찰은 이 시기 대북 교류 과정에서 쌍방울 그룹의 대북 송금이 이뤄졌다고 판단해 수사를 진행했습니다. 안 회장은 김성태 전 쌍방울 회장과 함께 2018년 12월과 2019년 1월 두 차례에 걸쳐 북한 조선아시아태평양평화위원회의 김영철 위원장에게 외화를 전달했다는 혐의를 받았습니다. 안 회장은 1심에서 징역 3년 6개월을 선고받았다가 2025년 2월 항소심에서 징역 1년 6개월로 감형됐습니다. 이와 관련된 ‘진술 회유 및 금품 수수’ 의혹으로 검찰 조사를 받기도 했습니다. 이후 이 대통령은 관련 혐의를 부인해 왔으나 현재도 법적·정치적 논란이 이어지며 이 대통령을 둘러싼 대표적인 사법 리스크 가운데 하나가 됐습니다.)

Restricted appointments of pro-Moon figures (친문 인사 기용 제한)

Beyond North Korea-related issues, President Lee was reportedly angered in September 2023 when, as party leader, a motion for his arrest in the National Assembly was passed, and he believed some pro-Moon lawmakers had voted in favor. This further widened the gap between the pro-Moon and pro-Lee factions. The depth of this conflict can be inferred from the limited appointments of pro-Moon figures since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration in June last year. Kim Hyun-jong, former deputy director of the National Security Office, who was once mentioned as a candidate for Foreign Minister, has also not appeared. Many pro-Moon figures who were active in the Lee Jae-myung campaign during the presidential election have also failed to secure positions in the new government. Although the recent presidential office meeting showed former and current Presidents Lee Jae-myung and Moon Jae-in embracing, the assessment both inside and outside the Democratic Party that "the pro-Moon and pro-Lee factions crossed a point of no return when Governor Lee Jae-myung was excluded from President Moon's visit to North Korea" still seems valid. (이 대통령은 북한과 관련된 문제 외에도 2023년 9월 당 대표 시절 자신에 대한 국회 체포동의안이 가결되자, 일부 친문 의원이 찬성한 것으로 보고 분노한 것으로 알려졌습니다. 이 과정에서 친문과 친명의 간극이 더욱 벌어졌습니다. 지난해 6월 이재명 정부 출범 이후 친문 인사들의 기용이 제한적으로 이뤄진 데서 그 갈등의 깊이를 짐작할 수 있습니다. 한때 외교부 장관 후보군으로 거론됐던 김현종 전 국가안보실 2차장도 모습을 드러내지 않고 있습니다. 대선 때 이재명 캠프에서 활동했던 상당수 친문 인사들도 새 정부에서 자리를 잡지 못했습니다. 이번 청와대 회동에서 이재명, 문재인 전현직 두 대통령이 포옹하는 모습이 공개됐지만, 민주당 안팎에서는 “친문과 친명은 이재명 경기 지사가 문 대통령 방북 때 배제되면서 돌아올 수 없는 다리를 건넜다”는 평가가 여전히 유효한 듯 합니다.)

item.title: "Election Commission Special Counsel Bill to Be Submitted This Week... Third-Party Recommendation is Fair" (與 “이번 주 선관위 특검법 제출…특검, 제3자 추천이 공정”)
item.description:
"Election Commission Special Counsel Bill to Be Submitted This Week... Third-Party Recommendation is Fair" (與 “이번 주 선관위 특검법 제출…특검, 제3자 추천이 공정”)

Han Byeong-do, the acting leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 5th, "We will submit the Election Commission Special Counsel Bill this week," adding, "We will focus on uncovering the substantive truth and punishing those responsible to restore public trust in election affairs." (더불어민주당 한병도 대표 직무대행은 5일 “이번 주 선관위 특검법을 제출하겠다”며 “실체적 진실을 밝히고 책임자를 처벌해 선거 사무에 대한 국민의 신뢰를 회복하는 데 집중하겠다”고 했다.)

Acting leader Han made this announcement on Facebook, saying, "The shortage of ballot papers, which infringed on the people's right to vote, is an unprecedented incident in constitutional history that cannot be excused by any justification." (한 대행은 이날 페이스북에서 “국민 참정권을 침해한 투표용지 부족은 그 어떤 변명으로도 용납할 수 없는 헌정사상 초유의 사태”라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Han emphasized, "A comprehensive investigation is necessary to leave no trace of doubt," and added, "The investigation will cover the circumstances of the reduction in ballot paper printing volume, the omission and delay in reporting to the command on election day, and internal corruption and incompetence within the Election Commission. Regardless of their position, all responsible parties will face legal judgment." (한 대행은 “단 한 점의 의혹도 남기지 않기 위해 전방위적인 수사가 필요하다”며 “투표용지 인쇄 물량 축소 경위, 선거일 지휘부 보고 누락 및 지연, 선관위 내부 부패와 무능까지 수사 대상에 포함하겠다. 지위 고하를 막론하고 책임자는 모두 법의 심판대에 세우겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party is arguing that the ruling party should be excluded from the recommendation authority for the Election Commission special counsel. In response, Acting leader Han said, "This is a strategic incitement not worth considering and is nonsense," noting, "Typically, a special counsel is recommended by the ruling party, the opposition party, and a third party, with one of them appointed by the president." (국민의힘은 선관위 특검 추천권에서 여당을 배제해야 한다고 주장하고 있다. 이에 대해 한 대행은 “일고의 가치도 없는 정략적 선동이자 어불성설”이라며 “통상 특검은 여당과 야당 그리고 제3자가 추천하고, 그중 1인을 대통령이 임명한다”고 했다.)

He further stated, "The Election Commission is an independent constitutional body. Regardless of party affiliation, we must work together to uncover the truth," and added, "For a special counsel that excludes political advantages and disadvantages, considering the Election Commission's special characteristics of independence and neutrality, a recommendation from a third party like the Korean Bar Association would be more realistic and fair." (그는 그러면서 “선관위는 헌법상 독립기관이다. 여야를 막론하고 진상규명에 함께해야 한다”며 “정치적 유불리를 배제한 특검이라면, 오히려 독립성과 중립성이라는 선관위의 특수성을 고려해 대한변협 등 제3자 추천이 더 현실적이고 공정할 것”이라고 했다.)

Acting leader Han urged, "This is not the time to bicker over the recommendation authority for the special counsel," and said, "If the People Power Party has no intention of using this incident politically, they should stop acting irresponsibly and throwing a tantrum." (한 대행은 “특검 추천권을 놓고 입씨름할 때가 아니다”라며 “국민의힘은 이번 사태를 정치적으로 활용할 생각이 없다면 더는 무책임한 몽니를 부리지 말아야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Attends Weapons Test on Previously Grounded 'Kang Kon-ho'… "To Be Commissioned Within 2 Months" (김정은, 좌초됐던 ‘강건호’ 무기시험 참관…“2개월 내 취역”)
item.description:
Kim Jong-un Attends Weapons Test on Previously Grounded 'Kang Kon-ho'… "To Be Commissioned Within 2 Months" (김정은, 좌초됐던 ‘강건호’ 무기시험 참관…“2개월 내 취역”)

North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un observed tests of major weapon systems, including missiles and naval guns, mounted on the 5,000-ton-class destroyer 'Kang Kon-ho.' The Kang Kon-ho had previously run aground in front of Chairman Kim during its launch ceremony last year. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 5000t급 구축함 ‘강건호’에 탑재된 미사일과 함포 등 주요 무기체계 시험을 참관했다. 강건호는 지난해 진수식 진행 당시 김 위원장의 눈앞에서 좌초된 바 있다.)

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 5th that "according to the plan for assessing the combat system performance of the destroyer 'Kang Kon-ho,' tests of major weapon systems, including a test launch of strategic cruise missiles, naval guns, automatic cannons, and electronic warfare means, were conducted on the 3rd." It further explained that "these tests are part of an evaluation process to review and confirm the combat applicability of various weapon systems mounted on the vessel." (조선중앙통신은 5일 “구축함 ‘강건호’의 전투체계 성능 평가 시험계획에 따라 3일 전략순항미사일 시험발사와 함상포 및 자동 기관포(총)들, 전자전 수단들을 비롯한 주요 무기체계들의 시험이 진행”됐다고 보도했다. 또 “해당 시험은 함에 탑재된 각종 무기 체계에대한 전투 적용성을 검토, 확증하기 위한 평가공정의 일환”이라고 설명했다.)

During the test, inspections of the vessel's target detection and information processing capabilities, as well as its integrated fire control system, were carried out. Following the firing of naval guns, a strategic cruise missile launch was conducted. The missiles are believed to be from the 'Arrow' series of cruise missiles, and North Korea is suspected of deploying them on new destroyers like the Choi Hyon-ho and Kang Kon-ho to use as maritime nuclear threat assets. (이날 시험에서는 함의 목표 탐지 및 정보 처리 능력, 통합 화력 체계에 대한 검열이 이뤄졌으며, 함상포 등 사격에 이어 전략 순항미사일 발사가 실시됐다. 미사일은 화살 계열 순항미사일로, 북한은 이를 최현호와 강건호 등 신형 구축함에 탑재해 해상 핵위협 수단으로 활용하려는 것으로 추측된다.)

Photos released by North Korean media show the missiles painted blue, raising possibilities of camouflage coloring. (북한 매체가 공개한 사진을 보면 미사일이 파란색으로 도장돼 있는데, 위장 도색일 가능성 등이 제기된다.)

Regarding the launch, the South Korean Joint Chiefs of Staff stated, "The military detected cruise missiles launched from the North Korean Kang Kon-ho into the East Sea on July 3, and detailed specifications are being precisely analyzed by South Korean and U.S. intelligence authorities." (합동참모본부는 이번 발사에 대해 “군은 7월 3일 북한 강건호에서 동해상으로 발사된 순항 미사일 등을 포착했고, 세부 제원은 한미 정보당국이 정밀 분석 중”이라고 했다.)

After observing the test from the coast, Chairman Kim stated, "Looking at the recent trends in our weapon system development, we can be confident in the potential of our style of naval combat system development, which provides great possibilities for changing the readiness posture of our military's strategic actions." (해안가에서 시험을 지켜본 뒤 김 위원장은 “최근 우리 무기체계 개발 동향을 보면 우리식 해군 전투체계 발전의 잠재성을 확신할 수 있으며 이는 우리 군대의 전략적 행동의 준비태세를 변화시키는 데서 커다란 가능성을 제공해준다”고 했다.)

He declared, "We must continue to vigorously push forward projects to maintain and steadily expand reliable war deterrence and war-fighting capabilities," and warned, "We will show our political will and determination to possess absolute power through clearer actions." (그는 “우리는 신뢰할 수 있는 전쟁 억제력과 전쟁 수행 능력을 유지하고 부단히 확대하기 위한 사업들을 계속 힘있게 다그쳐나가야 한다”며 “절대적인 힘을 보유하기 위한 우리의 정치적 의지와 결심을 더욱 명백한 행동으로 보여줄 것”이라고 예고했다.)

Recalling the content of the 2nd Expanded Plenary Meeting of the 9th Central Committee of the Workers' Party, which decided to expand naval-centric fleet bases and the capabilities of shipyards at various levels, Chairman Kim emphasized, "We will take national measures to strengthen our navy, which occupies an important position in protecting the country's maritime sovereignty and exercising war deterrence." (김 위원장은 해군 중심의 함대 기지 건설과 각급 조선소의 능력을 확대하기로 한 노동당 중앙위원회 제9기 제2차 전원회의 내용을 상기하면서 “국가의 해상주권 수호와 전쟁억제력행사에서 중요한 위치를 차지하는 우리 해군의 강화를 위하여 국가적인 조치들을 강구”하겠다고 강조했다.)

After encouraging officials from ship and weapon system research institutes, Chairman Kim instructed the navy to complete the test process for the 'Kang Kon-ho' and commission it within two months. Additionally, he convened an important meeting related to the development of the shipbuilding industry. item.title: Shin Jang-sik Declares Candidacy for Rebuilding Korea Party Leadership: "I Will Be the Left Wing of Korean Politics" (신장식, 조국혁신당 대표 출마 선언 “한국 정치 왼쪽 날개 되겠다”)
item.description:
Shin Jang-sik Declares Candidacy for Rebuilding Korea Party Leadership: "I Will Be the Left Wing of Korean Politics" (신장식, 조국혁신당 대표 출마 선언 “한국 정치 왼쪽 날개 되겠다”)

Shin Jang-sik, acting head of the Rebuilding Korea Party, declared on the 5th, "I will become the left wing of Korean politics," announcing his candidacy for the party leadership election at the national convention on the 25th of this month. (조국혁신당 신장식 대표 권한대행은 5일 “한국 정치의 레프트윙, 왼쪽 날개가 되겠다”며 이번 달 25일 전당대회 당대표 선거에 출마한다고 선언했다.)

Shin, holding a press conference at the National Assembly, stated, "Following the moderate and pragmatic line of a Lee Jae-myung administration, there will inevitably be a vacuum. I will make broader use of the left field in Korean politics." (신 대행은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “이재명 정부의 중도·실용 노선에 따라 필연적으로 공백이 생길 수밖에 없는, 한국 정치의 왼쪽 운동장을 더 넓게 쓰겠다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

He said, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is clearly adopting a moderate, pragmatic line and moving toward growth. It must succeed," while adding, "For a Lee Jae-myung administration to succeed, pragmatism and principle must stand together as two pillars. It is the role of the Rebuilding Korea Party to firmly establish the pillar of principle." (그는 “이재명 정부는 중도·실용 노선을 분명히 하고 성장을 향해 나아가고 있다. 성공해야 한다”면서도 “실용과 원칙, 두 기둥이 같이 서 있어야 이재명 정부는 성공할 수 있다. 원칙의 기둥을 단단히 세우는 것이 조국혁신당의 쓸모”라고 했다.)

Acting head Shin added, "I will firmly reorganize the party's foundation. I will restructure provincial party organizations and establish three major bodies: a special committee for organizational strengthening, a party constitution and rules committee, and a vision lab. I will redefine the identity of the Rebuilding Korea Party and equip it with clothing that fits us. I will concretize the party's platform and vision and prepare a long-term strategy for the 2028 general election." (신 대행은 “당의 기본을 단단히 정비하겠다. 시도당 조직을 재정비하고, 조직강화특별위원회, 당헌당규위원회, 비전랩 등 3대 기구를 설치하겠다”며 “조국혁신당의 정체성을 재정립하고 우리 몸에 맞는 옷을 갖추겠다. 당의 강령과 비전을 구체화하고 2028년 총선 장기 전략을 준비하겠다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I will break the vicious cycle where the AI transformation and ultra-gap growth deepen socioeconomic crises, and ensure they lead to a just, sustainable environment and a dignified life for the people. I will firmly uphold the grassroots spirit and the pillar of principle. We have pooled our efforts for the birth of a Lee Jae-myung administration. What is needed now is to once again strengthen the pillars of solidarity and integration." (이어 “AI 대전환과 초격차 성장이 사회경제적 위기를 심화시키는 악순환을 끊고, 정의롭고 지속 가능한 환경과 품격 있는 국민의 삶으로 이어질 수 있도록 하겠다”며 “광장의 초심과 원칙의 기둥은 튼튼히 지켜나가겠다. 우리는 이재명 정부의 탄생을 위해 힘을 모았다. 지금 필요한 것은 연대와 통합의 기둥을 다시금 굳건히 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Acting head Shin also mentioned former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan and late lawmaker Roh Hoe-chan, saying, "I will carry on the wisdom and courage of these two elders." (신 대행은 이해찬 전 국무총리와 노회찬 전 의원을 언급하며 “두 어른의 지혜와 용기를 이어가겠다”고도 했다.)

Shin, the senior supreme council member of the Rebuilding Korea Party, has led the party as acting head since former leader Cho Kuk stepped down following the defeat in the June 3 local elections. (조국혁신당 수석 최고위원인 신 대행은 조국 전 대표가 6·3 지방선거 패배로 대표직을 내려놓은 이후 권한대행으로 당을 이끌어왔다.)

item.title: "Jeong Cheong-rae Rejected Cabinet Position Offers from Both Moon and Lee Governments" (“정청래, 文정부·이재명 정부 장관 제안받았지만 거절”)
item.description:
"Jeong Cheong-rae Rejected Cabinet Position Offers from Both Moon and Lee Governments" (“정청래, 文정부·이재명 정부 장관 제안받았지만 거절”)

Poet Shin Dong-ho, who served as a speech secretary at the presidential office under the Moon Jae-in administration, said on the 5th, "As far as I know, former Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae received an offer to serve as a minister during the Moon Jae-in government, and also received a recent offer from the (Lee Jae-myung) government," adding that "Jeong declined." <<> Shin appeared on a YouTube channel hosted by Tak Hyun-min, who served as a protocol secretary at the presidential office under the Moon administration, and said, "Former leader Jeong had said before becoming a lawmaker that even if he entered politics, he would not take appointed positions." This YouTube program is one of Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel programs. <<> Shin added, "There might even be a role for him to help, as a minister, with what he truly wants to do—succeeding the Lee Jae-myung government. But he clearly wants to help through politics." He continued, "As a friend who has been by his side, the Jeong Cheong-rae I see is still keeping the promises we made back then." <<> He stated, "He is focused on being evaluated by the people, and he maintains an attitude where he feels no need to flatter those with power, authority, or those in charge of personnel appointments," adding, "I think that aspect of (former leader Jeong) is worth reevaluating." <<> Shin's remarks came while evaluating former President Kim Dae-jung's political activities, explaining that "he did not take appointed positions like minister and constantly sought evaluation and selection from the public." Shin said, "It may not be a fair comparison, but I speak with personal sentiment. I've seen former leader Jeong Cheong-rae up close because he's my friend," adding, "Former leader Jeong has never once held an appointed position." (문재인 정부 청와대 연설비서관을 지냈던 신동호 시인이 5일 “정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표가 문재인 정부 때 장관 제안을 받았고, 최근의 (이재명) 정부에서도 장관 제안을 받은 것으로 제가 알고 있다”며 “(정 전 대표가) 거절한 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik’s Mention of “Third Way” Sparks Discord in Democratic Party... Pro-Moon Camp Calls It “Opportunistic Scheming” (강훈식 “제3의 길” 언급에 민주당 분란...친청계 “기회주의적 협잡”)
item.description:
Kang Hoon-sik’s Mention of “Third Way” Sparks Discord in Democratic Party... Pro-Moon Camp Calls It “Opportunistic Scheming” (강훈식 “제3의 길” 언급에 민주당 분란...친청계 “기회주의적 협잡”)

Kang Hoon-sik, the presidential chief of staff, sparked backlash from some ruling party circles after mentioning a “Third Way” to embrace centrist voters during a Democratic Party workshop on the 3rd. Kang’s remarks align with President Lee Jae-myung’s emphasis on “expanding the Democratic Party’s base,” but among pro-Roh and pro-Moon supporters—the party’s traditional mainstay base—some said, “This disregards the comrades who helped us win power.” Lee Sang-ho, a close associate of former party leader Jung Cheong-rae, called it “opportunistic scheming.” <<> During the workshop on the 3rd, Kang reportedly outlined the administration’s policy direction and operational plans for its second year, stating that the Democratic Party needs to take a “Third Way” to appeal to centrist voters. Kang cited the example of the UK Labour Party, which transformed from a party representing the working class into a “party for everyone” by expanding its base. Kang also said that day, “We need to secure over 50% approval from the younger generation,” which was interpreted as an acknowledgment that the Democratic Party’s existing political norms make it difficult to regain support among those in their 20s and 30s. <<> However, as Kang’s comments became known, the party’s old guard reacted with resistance: “We supported him and made him president, but now that he’s in power, he talks about going a ‘Third Way.’” Ahead of the August 17 national convention to elect a new party leader, tensions are escalating between the so-called “New Lee Jae-myung” faction—the new mainstream—and the pro-Roh and pro-Moon forces representing the old guard. The New Lee Jae-myung camp supports Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, while the pro-Roh and pro-Moon camp largely backs former leader Jung. <<> Lee Sang-ho, a close ally of former leader Jung and key figure in the old pro-Roh faction, wrote on Facebook on the 4th: “A ‘Third Way’ aimed at the center sounds good, but that’s a stance for a government in power, not a path for a political party.” Lee added, “The ‘Third Way’ of Tony Blair’s UK Labour Party failed,” and argued, “When they say ‘Third Way,’ party members all know it really means ‘let’s join forces more broadly with people like Lee Un-ju.’ This is not integration but ‘opportunistic scheming.’” A party insider commented, “Doesn’t this imply that former leader Jung, who represents the party’s hardline stance and identity, should once again take the helm as party leader?” <<> Lee’s remarks amount to a direct rebuttal from Jung’s camp to the state affairs direction conveyed by Kang on behalf of President Lee Jae-myung’s administration. Inside and outside the party, there is speculation that “as the convention approaches, the confrontation and conflict between the ‘New Lee Jae-myung’ faction and the old guard will intensify.” (강훈식 대통령 비서실장이 지난 3일 더불어민주당 워크숍에서 중도층을 품기 위한 ‘제3의 길’을 언급한 것을 두고, 여권 일각에서 반발이 나오고 있다. 강 실장의 언급은 이재명 대통령이 강조하는 ‘민주당 외연 확장’과 같은 선상에 있는데, 민주당 옛 주류 지지층인 친노·친문 지지자들 사이에선 “집권에 도움을 준 동지들을 무시하는 것”이라는 말이 나왔다. 정청래 전 대표의 측근인 이상호씨는 “기회주의적 협잡”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kwak Sang-eon, Goes Live with Ddanzi Open, "Am I an Attention-Seeker? Should I Ask Them to Stop Paying Attention?" (곽상언, 딴지 켜놓고 라이브 “내가 관종? 관심 꺼달라 해야 하나”)
item.description:
Kwak Sang-eon, Goes Live with Ddanzi Open, "Am I an Attention-Seeker? Should I Ask Them to Stop Paying Attention?" (곽상언, 딴지 켜놓고 라이브 “내가 관종? 관심 꺼달라 해야 하나”)

Kwak Sang-eon, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea and son-in-law of former President Roh Moo-hyun, held a live broadcast on the 4th, refuting posts on the Ddanzi Ilbo bulletin board run by Kim Eo-joon, one by one. <<> That day, Rep. Kwak addressed a post titled "Kim Eo-joon, Kwak Sang-eon attacking Yoo Si-min: What score would his parliamentary activities get?" that had been uploaded to the Ddanzi bulletin board on the 23rd of last month. The post mentioned "Kwak Sang-eon, who became a congressman through Roh Moo-hyun's halo," "Kwak Sang-eon's parliamentary activities that constantly seek attention," and "Project 'Kwak Sang-eon's Path,' a desperate failure at drawing attention." <<> Rep. Kwak said, "I don't actually look at the Ddanzi bulletin board. I'm not even a member. In fact, I've never seen it before. There are many places where you can get information about the world." <<> Regarding the claim that he "planned a stunt to draw attention during the impeachment trial of former President Yoon Suk-yeol," Rep. Kwak rebutted, "I didn't do it to seek attention. Would I walk a whopping 500km nonstop from Seoul to Bongha Village for attention?" <<> He also said, "Is this an out-of-the-blue action? It's not. It's illegal to campaign during this period. What I did at the time was a legitimate presidential election campaign." <<> In response to criticism that "Rep. Kwak's attention-seeking has peaked," he said, "If you're interested in me, should I say thank you? Or should I ask you to stop paying attention?" He added, "This post itself is making me a target of hatred." <<> Regarding Kim Eo-joon, he said, "Why does this person have to be called 'boss'? Usually, we call them a publisher. Isn't 'boss' used for the top-ranked person in a special power group? If he wants it, anyone can get the title they want, so I can respect that." <<> On the claim that he "received the nomination for the Jongno district without a primary," Rep. Kwak said, "It was written to make it look like I was elected in Jongno without any campaigning, any effort, or any public support." <<> He also explained, "The Democratic Party finalized its nomination rules for the 22nd general election on May 8, 2023. The content was a rule that a single nomination would be given if the approval rating gap between the first- and second-place candidates in a district was 20% or more." (노무현 전 대통령의 사위인 더불어민주당 곽상언 의원은 4일 라이브 방송을 하며 김어준씨가 운영하는 딴지일보 게시판 글을 한 줄 한 줄 반박했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk, on the "Scary, No" Ilbe Distinction Method... Opposition Party: "Judging Ideology by One Word Ending?" (조국, ‘무섭노’ 일베 감별법에... 野 “말끝 하나로 사상 검증?”)
item.description:
Former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Cho Kuk, argued on the 5th that "Ilbe mechanically adds 'no' to the end of standard language," asserting the need to distinguish between the Gyeongsang dialect and the use of 'no' by Ilbe users. This follows controversy over girl group Rescene member Woni's remark "Museopno" (scary, no), which sparked so-called Ilbe debate. From the opposition, criticisms emerged such as "Are we trying to verify ideology based on a single word ending?" and "It's suffocating." <<> Former leader Cho posted on his Facebook that day, stating, "In ridiculing President Roh Moo-hyun, Ilbe adds 'no' to the end of sentences, and there are those who defend it, claiming Busan and the Gyeongsang region also use it that way." He then added, "In rebuttal, please refer to the following distinction method from a Busan native. From my observation, Ilbe mechanically attaches 'no' after standard language." <<> Cho's post came amid growing controversy over remarks by idol 'Woni,' originally from Geoje, South Gyeongsang Province, who said "Museopno" on YouTube. Online, reactions ranged from "It's Ilbe-style hate speech" to counterarguments that it's "natural dialect." <<> Former leader Cho also wrote, "In Gyeongsang questioning sentences, 'na' and 'no' are used distinctly: 'na' is used to confirm yes or no, while 'no' is used to request a specific explanation." This was interpreted as suggesting that, given the context of expressing fear, the phrase "Museopno" was inappropriate. <<> In response, criticism arose from the opposition. Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok said on his Facebook that day, "The person who talked about a bamboo spear in 2019 is now trying to verify ideology by a word ending." He remarked, "A twenty-two-year-old idol from Geoje, South Gyeongsang, said 'Museopno' in her hometown dialect, and she's been branded as Ilbe." <<> He continued, "The fact that 'no' became a meme among some of the younger generation was created by combining President Roh Moo-hyun's surname and the Gyeongsang dialect he used throughout his life. If we scold the meme creators and uproot the word entirely, then the Gyeongsang dialect becomes something only those people can use. That would be exactly the victory Ilbe most desires," he said. <<> People Power Party lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun also wrote on Facebook that day, "Do we have to pick apart even the dialect of an idol barely in her twenties to divide and rule?" calling it "a suffocating surveillance society." He said, "Former Cho Kuk Innovation Party leader Cho, as if waiting for this, posted guidelines as 'Ilbe distinction method.' The act of branding even a dialect as mechanical Ilbe expression is shocking beyond belief." <<> Similar criticisms continued from the pro-government side. Ha Heon-ki, former standing deputy spokesperson of the Democratic Party of Korea, said, "Because a young singer said 'Museopno,' a pretentious show-off party is underway to determine whether she's an Ilbe user mocking President Roh Moo-hyun or just using the Gyeongsang dialect." He added, "Especially those who lived through or near the era when people were accused of being communists or receiving orders from North Korea for carrying 'Capital' in their school bags as youths, and now as middle-aged people acting this way, it's not just pathetic but utterly ridiculous." <<> He then said, "Speech has context. You can't distinguish solely by one ending whether someone is deeply into Ilbe and mocking President Roh Moo-hyun, or whether they're naturally using a word that has already lost its original meaning and become universalized." (조국혁신당 조국 전 대표가 5일 “일베는 표준말 뒤에 기계적으로 ‘노’를 붙여 사용한다”며 영남 사투리와 일베 이용자들이 쓰는 ‘노’ 사용을 구별해야 한다는 취지로 주장했다. 최근 걸그룹 리센느 멤버 원이가 “무섭노”라고 발언한 데 대해 이른바 ‘일베’ 논란이 나온 데 따른 것이다. 야권에서는 “말끝 하나로 사상을 검증하려 하는 것이냐” “숨 막힌다”는 비판이 나왔다.)

item.title: Yoon Sang-hyun: "Pushing for Public Recount of 2.47 Million Ballots at Olympic Park Tallying Station" (윤상현 “올림픽공원 개표소 투표지 247만장 공개 재검표 추진”)
item.description:
Rep. Yoon Sang-hyun of the People Power Party, who serves as chair of the National Assembly's special committee on the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections, announced on the 5th that he plans to push for a "public recount" of 2.47 million ballots stored at the Olympic Park Handball Stadium in Seoul, in connection with the ballot paper shortage during the June 3 local elections. <<> At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the same day, Rep. Yoon said, "Since the week before last, I have been requesting Acting Central Election Commission Chair Wi Cheol-hwan to publicly re-verify the validity of those 2.47 million ballots," adding, "Shouldn't the election commission also need to show that there were no errors in the voting and counting process?" <<> Rep. Yoon noted, "The cost of leasing the stadium until July 10 is about 200 million won, but mobilizing personnel for a recount is expected to cost around 50 million won," adding, "Rather than continuing to incur costs by leasing the space, conducting a thorough recount all at once would provide a justification for moving those sealed ballot boxes." <<> Rep. Yoon stated that he has requested the senior and junior secretaries of the special committee to discuss this proposal. He said, "I have asked them to consult between the ruling and opposition party secretaries, and I believe a conclusion will come soon," adding, "During last week's briefing from the Central Election Commission, Acting Secretary-General Kang Dong-wan also expressed a positive view, saying 'sounds good, let's do it.'" <<> Meanwhile, Rep. Yoon stated that during the planned on-site inspection of the Central Election Commission and the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission on the 7th, he will focus on scrutinizing the "process of deciding to reduce the printing of main ballots by 50%" and the "issue of gaps in the command and reporting system." <<> Rep. Yoon said, "The decision to reduce printing involved a full meeting chaired by former Election Commission Chair Noh Tae-ak last November, and it was documented in a 40-page report, but only two people remember it, and the remaining seven cannot even recall being briefed on it," adding, "We will also look into the issue of handling matters related to ballot papers through delegated authority regulations instead of establishing them as Central Election Commission rules." (국회 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특위 위원장인 국민의힘 윤상현 의원은 5일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해, 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에 보관 중인 247만표에 대한 ‘공개 재검표’를 추진할 계획이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Ruling Party and Government Pledge Full Support for AI Center Power and Permits… Utilizing 'Additional' Tax Revenue (당정 “AI센터 전력·인허가 전폭 지원…‘추가’ 세수 활용”)
item.description:
On the 5th, the ruling party and government announced the establishment of a "Future Response Fund" for the "Three Mega Projects for South Korea's Great Leap Forward," which aim to intensively foster semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, and physical AI as strategic industries. (당정은 반도체·인공지능(AI) 데이터센터·피지컬 AI를 전략사업으로 집중 육성하는 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트’를 위해 ‘미래대응기금’을 신설하겠다고 5일 밝혔다.)

At a high-level ruling party-government consultative meeting held at the Seoul Prime Minister's Residence that day, the direction for pushing forward the three mega projects, the second-half national administration direction, and legislative strategies for key bills were discussed. (이날 서울 국무총리 공관에서 열린 고위당정협의회에서 3대 메가프로젝트 추진 방향과 하반기 국정 운영 방향 및 중점 추진 법안 입법 전략이 논의됐다.)

After the meeting, Kang Joon-hyun, senior spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, stated, "We agree with the government's position to use additional tax revenue for future generations and to address polarization in South Korea's growth engines." He added, "The ruling party, government, and presidential office will closely cooperate to support the three mega projects and establish a future response fund." (회의가 끝난 뒤 강준현 더불어민주당 수석대변인은 “추가 세수를 미래세대와 대한민국 성장동력 양극화 대응 등에 사용하겠다는 정부 입장에 공감한다”며 “당정청은 3대 메가 프로젝트 지원과 미래 대응 기금 신설 등을 긴밀히 협력해나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

At the meeting, the Ministry of Economy and Finance reportedly used the term "additional tax revenue" instead of "excess tax revenue." The amount to be managed by the fund has not yet been finalized. (이날 회의에서 기획예산처는 ‘초과 세수’ 대신 ‘추가 세수’라는 표현을 썼다고 한다. 기금에서 운용하는 액수 등은 아직 확정되지 않았다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang said that day, "We will fully support power site permits to ensure no disruptions in the construction of AI data centers, and actively promote support projects to foster AI data centers and physical AI as unrivaled export industries." (강 수석대변인은 이날 “AI데이터센터 구축에 차질이 발생하지 않도록 전력 부지 인허가를 전폭적으로 지원하고, AI 데이터센터 및 피지컬AI를 독보적인 수출산업으로 육성하기 위한 지원사업도 적극 추진 예정”이라고 했다.)

He also stated, "To respond to large-scale power demand, we will preemptively expand power infrastructure, and to stably supply water, we have decided to establish a multi-source water system." (또 “대규모 전력 수요 대응위해 전력 인프라를 선제적 확충하고 용수를 안정적으로 공급하기 위해 다중 수원체계를 구축하기로 했다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Blue House: “Establishing a ‘Future Response Fund’ with Additional Semiconductor Tax Revenue” (靑 “반도체 추가세수로 ‘미래 대응 기금’ 신설 추진”)
item.description:
Blue House: “Establishing a ‘Future Response Fund’ with Additional Semiconductor Tax Revenue” (靑 “반도체 추가세수로 ‘미래 대응 기금’ 신설 추진”)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said on the 5th, “The Lee Jae-myung administration plans to push for the establishment of a Future Response Fund to use additional tax revenue as investment resources for future generations.” <<> Chief Kang stated at a high-level ruling party-government consultation meeting held at the Prime Minister’s residence that day, “We aim to create a fund with additional tax revenue to make bold investments in Korea’s future, including generating future growth engines through support for three mega-projects, addressing K-shaped polarization, and providing housing, startup, and job support for the youth in their 20s and 30s.” <<> Chief Kang added, “The establishment of the Future Response Fund will serve as the cornerstone for realizing an ‘Irreplaceable Republic of Korea,’” and urged, “I ask for cooperation between the ruling party and the government so that it can be pushed forward with speed.” <<> The additional tax revenue expected to be collected by early next year due to the semiconductor boom is around up to 100 trillion won. Various opinions have emerged within and outside the government on how to most effectively utilize this money. There were mentions of a ‘national dividend’ within the Blue House, and some in the business community suggested using a portion to pay off national debt. <<> Amid this, Chief Kang announced the plan to push for the establishment of a new fund. He said, “At this critical moment that will determine Korea’s future, we must not waste the additional tax revenue generated by the semiconductor boom.” <<> At the high-level meeting that day, the focus was on discussing the implementation plan for the ‘three mega-projects’ announced by President Lee Jae-myung at the Blue House on the 29th of last month, including semiconductors, artificial intelligence (AI) data centers, and physical AI. Regarding the three mega-projects, Chief Kang said, “This is about designing new growth engines that will determine Korea’s future for the next 20 to 30 years,” and added, “The second year of the administration is the time to swiftly realize an ‘Irreplaceable Republic of Korea’ and create tangible results for the people, and the three mega-projects will be the historical starting point.” <<> (강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 5일 “이재명 정부는 추가 세수를 미래 세대를 위한 투자 재원으로 활용하기 위해 미래 대응 기금 신설을 추진하고자 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Nam-joon, Former Blue House Spokesperson: “Lee Byung-tae Must Resign Voluntarily” (靑 대변인 출신 김남준 “이병태 자진 사퇴해야”)
item.description:
Kim Nam-joon, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea and a former Blue House spokesperson considered a key confidant of President Lee Jae-myung, stated on the 5th, “Vice Chairman Lee Byung-tae should resign voluntarily.” (이재명 대통령 핵심 측근으로 꼽히는 청와대 대변인 출신의 김남준 더불어민주당 의원이 5일 “이병태 부위원장은 자진사퇴해야 한다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Lee Byung-tae, vice chairman of the Regulatory Rationalization Committee, posted on his Facebook about the heavy disciplinary action of a six-month game suspension imposed on Baejae High School for chanting “Let’s go to Starbucks” during a match against Gwangju Jeil High School, saying, “The May 18 Democratic Uprising has become a sacred cow. It resembles North Korea.” In response, the Blue House had previously stated, “We have issued a stern warning and strongly requested that such incidents not recur.” (앞서 이병태 규제합리화위원회 부위원장은 배재고가 광주제일고와의 경기 중 ‘스타벅스 가야지’라는 응원 구호를 외쳐 6개월 출전 금지 중징계 처분이 내려진 것을 두고 자신의 페이스북에 “5·18이 성역이 됐다. 북한의 모습”이라고 말했다. 그러자 청와대는 “엄중히 경고하고 향후 재발 방지를 강력히 요청했다”고 한 바 있다.)

Following fellow ruling party lawmakers, Kim Nam-joon also wrote on his Facebook that day, “The vice chairman of a presidential committee, who cannot be dismissed due to a guaranteed two-year term, used language such as ‘sacred cow’ and ‘North Korea’ amidst the controversy over mocking the May 18 movement, shaking the historical foundation of South Korea’s democracy.” (범여권 의원들에 이어 김남준 의원도 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “2년 임기 보장으로 해촉 불가능한 대통령 직속 위원회 부위원장이 5·18 조롱 논란을 두고 “성역화”, “북한”이라는 언어를 사용하며 대한민국 민주주의의 역사적 기반을 흔들었다”라고 했다.)

He further criticized, “While academic discussion and criticism are permissible, ridiculing or trivializing a history of suffering cannot be justified under the name of freedom of expression. This is even more unacceptable for a public official.” (또 “학문적 토론과 비판은 가능하지만, 피해의 역사를 조롱하거나 희화화하는 일을 표현의 자유라는 이름으로 감쌀 수는 없다”며 “공직자라면 더더욱 해서는 안 될 태도”라고 비판했다.)

He added, “Vice Chairman Lee Byung-tae can express his opinions as a free citizen. However, he cannot continue making remarks that undermine national unity and constitutional values while holding the title of vice chairman of a presidential committee.” (그러면서 “이병태 부위원장은 자유로운 시민으로 자신의 견해를 말할 수 있다. 그러나 대통령 직속 위원회 부위원장의 직함을 단 채 국민 통합과 헌정 가치를 훼손하는 발언을 계속할 수는 없다”고 했다.)

Kim stated, “Since he cannot be dismissed, stepping down on his own is the minimum responsibility to the people and the appointing authority. Voluntary resignation is the answer.” (김 의원은 “해촉이 불가한 만큼 스스로 물러나는 것이 국민과 임명권자에 대한 최소한의 책임”이라며 “자진사퇴가 답”이라고 했다.)

On that day, many lawmakers within the ruling camp voiced criticism against Vice Chairman Lee. Lawmaker Kim Nam-guk said, “The act of trivializing the tragedy where the state aimed guns at its citizens and the history where citizens defended democracy with their lives cannot be wrapped in the name of freedom of expression. He should immediately apologize to the people for his incorrect perceptions and outrageous remarks.” (이날 여권에서는 많은 의원들이 이 부위원장에 대한 비판 목소리를 냈다. 김남국 의원은 “국가가 국민에게 총부리를 겨눈 비극과 시민들이 목숨으로 민주주의를 지켜낸 역사를 희화화하는 행위까지 표현의 자유로 감쌀 수는 없다”며 “잘못된 인식과 망언에 대해 국민 앞에 즉각 사죄하라”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Seo Young-seok also stated, “Hatred and mockery toward the May 18 Democratic Uprising cannot be justified under the guise of freedom of expression. Apologizing now for demeaning the history of democracy is the proper attitude for someone in public office.” (서영석 의원도 “5·18 민주화운동을 향한 혐오와 조롱이 표현의 자유라는 이름으로 정당화될 수 없다”며 “지금이라도 민주주의의 역사를 폄훼한 것에 대해 사과하는 것이 공직에 있는 사람의 올바른 태도”라고 했다.)

Park Byung-eon, senior spokesperson for the Fatherland Innovation Party, commented, “The May 18 Democratic Uprising is a history that forms the backdrop of current South Korean society, to the extent that there is public consensus to include it in the preamble of the Constitution. An individual who directly raises the issue of labeling it as ‘like North Korea’ should not be tolerated in the name of unity.” (조국혁신당 박병언 선임대변인은 논평을 통해 “5·18 민주화운동은 헌법전문에 수록하는 데 국민적 합의가 있을 정도로 지금의 한국 사회의 배경이 되는 역사”라며 “이에 대해 ‘북한 같다’며 정면으로 색깔론을 제기한 인사까지 통합이라는 이름으로 용인해서는 안 된다”고 말했다.)
